method: fixture spawns a detached `node -e setTimeout` sleeper, then closes the host; direct pid check and Win32_Process table sampled every 250 ms for 60 s + 20 s + 20 s
taskkill: not run; the sleeper was already gone, so there was no tree to target
finding: The detached grandchild did not survive the sampling window on windows-latest, and the sampler saw it alive after close before it went away. The mechanism is not visible from here; a hosted runner may reap the tree with a job object, so this is 'none observed in the measured case', not a guarantee. A desktop with no runner job object is still unmeasured, and no taskkill reaper is warranted.
